title: Crestline Companion Hawaii Surcharge Retention: Repeat-Refund Scale
content:
The surcharge retention kept from a Hawaii surcharge refund on a Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes product is scaled by the Hawaii surcharge refunds already recorded on the certificate or pass with an entry date in the last 12 months, counted back from the handling date.

| Hawaii surcharge refunds already recorded on the certificate or pass in the last 12 months | Scale applied to the surcharge retention |
|---|---|
| two or more | multiplied by 1.5 |
| exactly one | multiplied by 1.2 |
| none | left unscaled |

- Only refund entries of component Hawaii surcharge on the same certificate or pass are counted; refunds of the companion fare or of taxes and fees are not.
- A Hawaii surcharge refund dated more than 12 months before the handling date is not counted.

**Hypothetical cases.** With a surcharge retention of 25.00 USD, one earlier Hawaii surcharge refund in the last 12 months gives 30.00 USD; two or more give 37.50 USD; none leaves 25.00 USD.
